title: Cladistics of Shared 'Synapomorphies': Finding Telltale Homogeneous Quirks Inherited Across Models

original_idea.body:
# Cladistics of Shared Synapomorphies

Define a battery of distinctive behavioral characters (specific quirk present/absent) and score them across ~15 open models; build a character matrix and identify synapomorphies shared across supposedly independent lineages. Inference + character scoring.

theory_of_impact.reasoning: Level 3: plausible chain (trait-level convergence diagnoses correlated-failure mechanism) but the catastrophic link is indirect.

accessible_complexity.reasoning: Level 4: define a quirk-character battery and build a character matrix; character coding adds subjectivity/effort.

narrow_scope.reasoning: Level 4: focused deliverable (synapomorphy character matrix) but designing the quirk battery is somewhat open-ended.

counterfactual_value.reasoning: Level 4: public models + behavioral analysis, no internal access, labs underweight.

novelty.reasoning: A cladistic synapomorphy analysis of LLM quirks appears largely novel.

novelty_assessment.reasoning: No known cladistic synapomorphy analysis of LLM behavioral quirks.
